title: Glue compactifications across an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces

standard_prerequisites.use: Algebraic spaces, elementary distinguished squares, blowups and strict transforms, etale pushouts, properness and its refined valuative criterion, and common blowup domination. The required local boundary-separation and finite-flat blowup lemmas are retained.

core_obligations: Arrange compatible admissible blowups of two compactifications so their boundary loci separate and the local finite-flat lifting condition holds.
Construct separated pushout candidates and use valuation-ring extensions plus common blowups to prove a proper global compactification exists.

proof_roadmap.step: Arrange compatible admissible blowups of two compactifications so their boundary loci separate and the local finite-flat lifting condition holds.
Construct separated pushout candidates and use valuation-ring extensions plus common blowups to prove a proper global compactification exists.

difficulty_reason: The argument must coordinate several boundary modifications before the two valuation-extension cases can be joined. The necessary separatedness and properness do not follow from the existence of the two original compactifications alone; the retained construction is H2.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.

dedup.scope: Compared fixed tag/file/claim against local manifest, same-chapter primary titles/locators, 400 retired claims, research main-overlap and preparation worklist. Related standard tools and included support are not separately counted. No remote freshness or historical novelty asserted.

editorial_notes: The author writes X_1 minus Zbar_1,2 union Tbar without parentheses at3443. The surrounding3460–3461 fixes the intended removal of the union of both closed sets; the original display is retained.
At3477–3480 the closed map is understood on the closure of the lifting locus, as explicitly named in3478 and3498; this is the proper closure used to lift a boundary geometric point.
The old dump was truncated near3475. The task retains the full original proof through3538, including the decisive valuation-extension close.
